# Desire Agency

> An honest, sourced recommendation of n8n, plus a directory of 19 automation and AI-agent tools. English is primary; German is under /de/.

Live site: https://maximussoroka.github.io/
Operator: Saveliy Soroka, Lisboa. Contact: desire.studio.agency@gmail.com (see /legal/).
Prices and programme terms: official public vendor pages, checked on 18 November 2026 (Europe/Madrid).
Own revenue so far: €0. No earnings promises. Not financial advice.
Products: Agent Team Guide (https://desireagencyai.gumroad.com/l/blhhwg, $19), free Trading Journal + Risk Sheet (https://desireagencyai.gumroad.com/l/htrxgl).
Elsewhere: X https://x.com/desire__agency · dev.to https://dev.to/desire_agency · Indie Hackers https://www.indiehackers.com/desireagency.
There are no active affiliate links. Future affiliate links, if any, will be labelled #ad / Anzeige.
This is a static site with no cookies, tracking or analytics.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/): Desire Agency, an AI agent team built in public from Lisbon. Real numbers including the zeros (revenue so far €0), products (Agent Team Guide, free trading journal, free n8n templates), why we recommend n8n, and sourced cloud-pricing facts as of 18 November 2026.
- [Home (German)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/de/): The same start page in German.
- [n8n recommendation (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/n8n/): Sourced article on n8n, self-hosting, and a fair comparison with Make. Buttons go to the official n8n site; the n8n partner application was declined on 19 November 2026.
- [n8n recommendation (German)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/de/n8n/): The same article in German.
- [Tool directory (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/directory/): 19 sourced entries (n8n listed first). Each entry has a short description, official and pricing URLs, and a price field. Where a figure was not reliably readable, it is marked unknown. schema.org JSON-LD (ItemList of SoftwareApplication) is embedded in the page.
- [Tool directory (German)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/de/directory/): The same directory in German, with the same JSON-LD in German wording.
- [Free n8n templates (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/templates/): Three free, importable n8n workflows (RSS digest email, form to Google Sheet, website uptime alert with a 60-second retry before the alert). Each section has setup steps and a download link to workflow.json. Credentials in the files are placeholders only. There is no German version of this page.
- [Legal notice / Impressum (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/legal/): Operator, address, contact, advertising note, and privacy (static site, no cookies or tracking).
- [Legal notice / Impressum (German)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/de/legal/): The same legal notice in German.
- [Websites (English)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/websites/): Website service for small businesses: Vitrine (one page) from €390, Atelier (3–5 pages) from €750, Maison (up to 8 pages, two languages) from €1,190, Care €29/month. Final prices. No VAT charged – exempt under Art. 53 CIVA (Portugal). Delivery times count from the complete briefing. Enquiries by contact form (delivered via FormSubmit) or email; no online payment. Payment after completion, no deposit.
- [Websites (German)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/de/websites/): The same service page in German.
- [Websites (European Portuguese)](https://maximussoroka.github.io/pt/websites/): The same service page in Portuguese (pt-PT). "Preços finais. IVA isento ao abrigo do artigo 53.º do CIVA."
- [Demos](https://maximussoroka.github.io/demos/): Six example sites for fictional small businesses (Lisbon barbearia, bilingual tasca, Christmas campaign tasca, sapateiro; Dublin café; Bristol handyman), clearly labelled as demos.
- [Desire Agency newsletter](https://desireagency.beehiiv.com/subscribe): Sign-up page for the free “build log” newsletter. No earnings promises.

## Machine-readable

- [tools.json](https://maximussoroka.github.io/tools.json): JSON copy of all 19 directory entries in English and German, including official URLs, pricing URLs, sourced price text, and price-status. No affiliate links.
- [sitemap.xml](https://maximussoroka.github.io/sitemap.xml): URL list for this site.
- [robots.txt](https://maximussoroka.github.io/robots.txt): Allows indexing and points to the sitemap.

## Optional

- Do not invent prices or programme terms. If a field is unknown or partial, say so and send readers to the vendor's official page.
- Product buttons currently go to official vendor sites (https://n8n.io/, https://www.make.com/), not to affiliate URLs.
